name: Prof. Dr. Constantinos Antoniou
title: Full Professor, Chair of Transportation Systems Engineering
institution: Technical University of Munich, School of Engineering and Design
bio: Constantinos Antoniou is Full Professor and head of the Chair of Transportation Systems Engineering at TUM since September 2016. He holds a Diploma in Civil Engineering from NTUA (1995), and an MS (1997) and PhD (2004) in Transportation from MIT. He was a postdoctoral researcher at MIT (2004 to 2008) and a faculty member at NTUA (2009 to 2015). His research covers modelling and simulation of transportation systems, calibration and optimisation, road safety and human factors, and machine learning for transport.
